message.content:
An upright, rectangular magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters features an illustration of a pinball machine. Two sets of hands hold the sides of the machine at the bottom. The pinball playfield is rendered in wood, red, and black, with a large five-pointed orange star at the base. Two red-and-yellow flippers are positioned above the star. 

The machine contains various bumpers and obstacles. Ten distinct caricatures of people’s faces are integrated into the playfield’s components. One large central figure is shown from the chest up, wearing a black shirt. Below him, the red and white text reads "KOMPROMI BABAK BELUR." Smaller white text underneath says: "Disemprot pimpinan partai koalisi, Jokowi justru membatalkan pencalonan Budi Gunawan. Kriminalisasi jalan terus." 

Additional text at the top reads "INVESTIGASI: KONGLOMERAT PENCURI IKAN" above the date "23 FEBRUARI-1 MARET 2015." The bottom right corner displays a barcode and price "RP 39.500." A small black pinball sits near the left flipper. The entire scene is framed by a thin red border on the left side.
